rationale: The stock has already dropped ~19% from yesterday's open on a significant earnings miss (EPS miss of 57%, subscriber shortfall), and is now trading near the session low at 4.4% of today's range with price compressed in a tight band around $18.57-$18.66 over the last five minutes — no clear directional momentum is present.
